title: DrivePulse webhook message, schema 1
description: The JSON body the DrivePulse app POSTs to a webhook (Home Assistant or any other receiver). Every key below is always present, with null when the car did not give that value, except `custom` (sent from app 3.5.9) and `trip` (only with `trip_end` and `trip_resend`). Units are always metric. The message never carries a GPS position, an address or the VIN. A newer app can add keys, here, in `extended` and in `trip`: ignore the ones you do not know. None of them will ever be a position, an address or the VIN.

schema.description: The format version. A message with a different number follows a different schema.

event.description: live: periodic while the adapter is connected (only if live sending is on). trip_start: a trip started. trip_end: a trip ended and was saved; carries `trip`. trip_resend: the user sent a saved trip again by hand (from app 3.6.2); carries `trip`, every other value is null and `obd_connected` is false: it is not a reading of the car now, and not a trip that just ended. test: the test button in the app.

sent_at.description: When the app built the message, UTC (for example 2026-10-10T08:00:00.000Z).

units.description: Always metric, whatever units the app shows.

vehicle.description: The vehicle's name as written in the app (with trip_resend: the vehicle of that trip). Not the VIN.

obd_connected.description: Whether the app was talking to the car when it built the message. False with the test button away from the car, at trip_end when the engine is already off, and always with trip_resend.

obd_at.description: UTC time of the OBD reading the values come from (at trip_end with the adapter gone: the last reading of the trip). Null when there is none.

speed_kmh.description: Vehicle speed from the car, km/h.

coolant_temp_c.description: Engine coolant temperature, °C. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

battery_voltage.description: 12 V battery voltage, V, two decimals. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

fuel_level_pct.description: Fuel tank level, %, one decimal. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

consumption_l_100km.description: Instantaneous fuel consumption, l/100 km, one decimal.

trip_km.description: Distance of the current trip, km, two decimals (0 at trip_start; the trip's distance at trip_end).

fuel_level_l.description: Fuel in the tank, litres, one decimal, when the car gives it. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

range_km.description: Range shown by the car, km, one decimal, when the car gives it. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

hv_soc_pct.description: Charge of the high-voltage battery of an electric or hybrid car, %, one decimal. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip.

odometer_km.description: Odometer, km, one decimal, when the car gives it. At trip_end, the last value read in the trip, or the trip's end odometer.

dtc.description: The stored trouble codes (for example P0420). Null when the app has not read them.

extended.description: Extended readings, only the ones the car actually sent in this message (no null values). Can be empty. A newer app can add readings.

maf_gs.description: Mass air flow, g/s, one decimal.

timing_advance_deg.description: Ignition timing advance, degrees, one decimal.

distance_with_mil_km.description: Distance driven with the engine warning light on, km.

distance_since_clear_km.description: Distance since the trouble codes were last cleared, km.

dpf_delta_kpa.description: Particulate filter differential pressure, kPa, two decimals.

dpf_soot_calc_g.description: Particulate filter soot mass, calculated, g, one decimal.

dpf_soot_meas_g.description: Particulate filter soot mass, measured, g, one decimal.

dpf_regen_active.description: Whether the particulate filter is regenerating now.

dpf_km_since_regen.description: Distance since the last particulate filter regeneration, km, one decimal.

hv_soh_pct.description: High-voltage battery state of health, %, one decimal.

fuel_level_l.description: Fuel in the tank, litres, one decimal.

range_km.description: Range shown by the car, km, one decimal.

custom.description: Custom PIDs the user turned on in the app that have a value, under their own key `cp<id>`, which does not change when the PID is renamed. Can be empty. Sent from app 3.5.9.

name.description: The name the user gave the PID.

value.description: The value, rounded to the PID's decimals (an integer with zero decimals).

unit.description: The unit the user gave the PID.

trip.description: The trip summary, only with trip_end and trip_resend. No start or end place, no route: about places there is only the yes or no of ended_at_home. A newer app can add keys.

id.description: The trip's number in the app.

avg_consumption_l_100km.description: Average consumption, l/100 km, one decimal. Not on an electric car.

avg_consumption_kwh_100km.description: Average consumption, kWh/100 km, one decimal. Only on an electric car.

odometer_km.description: Odometer at the end of the trip, km, one decimal.

ended_at_home.description: Did the trip end inside a Home place saved for this car in the app? A yes or no worked out on the phone, never a position, place name or address. null when the switch in the app is off (the default), when this car has no Home place (one saved on another car does not count), or when GPS was lost before the car stopped. Always null with trip_resend. Missing from apps before 3.6.2.
